name: Pick
text:
Decision: Focus first on GitHub and Product Hunt, then expand to Reddit and Telegram.

Reason: GitHub and Product Hunt give us the clearest signals of AI projects that are actually shipping code or gaining traction with users. Reddit and Telegram are noisy and harder to mine reliably. We’ll get higher-quality leads faster by starting here.

Trade-off: We’re delaying the “diverse sources” part of the goal, but we’re making sure the first batch of leads is solid. We can circle back to Reddit/Telegram once we’ve got a working pipeline.
